title: Source preview: realized spatial amplitude and Bloch phase, polarization vector, effective bandwidth, fixed-k_parallel incidence with the angle range, refusal of a fixed-angle definition

fixture.bloch_sheet: 2D cell 1.2 x 2.2 um, mesh 0.03 um, 10 PML cells on y, Bloch on x with phase kx * 1.2 for kx = 2 pi sin(theta) / lambda; Ez soft sheet at y = -0.6 um spanning the cell; Gaussian 3 cycles at 1.02 um; theta 20 deg (propagating across the band) and 80 deg (evanescent at the long-wavelength edge); 1500 or 4000 steps
fixture.other_sources: demo scatterer sheet (periodic y, normal incidence), demo point source, a one-way plane on a periodic 2D cell, a TFSF box, a theta/phi vector point source (60, 30 deg, amplitude 0.5)
fixture.bandwidth_definition: outermost DFT bins where the single-sided amplitude spectrum of the injected samples is at least 0.01 of its peak (-40 dB), unwindowed, over the whole simulation interval
fixture.registry: torchfdtd.capabilities.INCIDENCE served in /api/capabilities['combinations']['incidence']; feature inventory rows source.angle and boundary.bfast
fixture.workbench: tests/ui/source-preview.spec.js: Bloch sheet at 20 deg on a 1.2 um cell, incidence text, spatial phase tab, fixed-angle refusal, normal-incidence sheet

reference_method: closed forms: k_parallel = phi / L, sin(theta) = k_parallel lambda / (2 pi n), spatial phase phi (x - x0) / L; the Gaussian amplitude spectrum exp(-2 pi^2 sigma^2 (f - f0)^2) for the 1 percent band; the source polarization unit vector; the registry constants

observables.name: angle_deg
observables.definition: incidence['angle_deg'] at the carrier and at the band edges and peak

observables.name: phase_rad_by_axis
observables.definition: spatial[k]['phase_rad_by_axis'] relative to the first cell of the line

observables.name: fixed_angle_refusal
observables.definition: the ValueError message of preview_source(incidence='fixed_angle') and the 422 detail of the route

acceptance.incidence: kind fixed_k_parallel on a Bloch cell, normal without Bloch phase, not applicable for a point source; carrier angle equals the declared angle to 1e-9 deg; band-edge angles follow asin(k_parallel lambda / 2 pi n) exactly and decrease with frequency; an edge with k_parallel > n k0 has angle None with the reason evanescent
acceptance.spatial: the Bloch phase line equals phi (x - x_first) / L to 1e-12 rad on every sheet cell; the one-way plane and the TFSF box report their cut or box cells and no spatial phase; vector sources report one term per nonzero component with amplitude |amplitude * weight|
acceptance.bandwidth: the 1 percent band edges of a 3-cycle Gaussian match f0 +- sqrt(ln 100 / 2) / (pi sigma) within 1.5 frequency bins; a disabled source has no band and says so
acceptance.refusal: a fixed-angle request raises ValueError with INCIDENCE['fixed_angle']['message'], the route answers 422 with that text, the registry marks fixed_angle rejected and the inventory rows source.angle and boundary.bfast missing; the workbench shows the refusal instead of a plot
acceptance.source_of_limits: G6-02 specification; the 1 percent bandwidth threshold and the bin tolerance are declared here before the run

not_yet_covered: a 3D cell with Bloch phase on two transverse axes (the per-axis phase lines are reported but only the 2D single-axis case is asserted)
the spatial profile of a sampled (user time table) source's spectrum against its declared wavelength
a fixed-angle source, which does not exist: the refusal is the contract until BFAST-like injection is implemented

notes: Declared at 73203d2 before the run. The preview reports the incidence the solver realizes; it does not synthesize a fixed-angle source and the registry entry says so.
